digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 12 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源编码智能体，让 AI 直接操作终端与文件，自主完成从需求到代码的闭环任务

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的模块化能力，大幅降低复杂任务开发门槛

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: 规范驱动开发起步工具箱，用声明式规格约束代码生成与演进，让团队从文档到实现始终对齐

repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: 统一大模型 API 并内置 Agent 循环、TUI 与编码 CLI，一套工具打通 AI 应用开发全流程

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
repos.description: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: 全网网页抓取与结构化解析的统一 API，让 AI 应用轻松搜索、爬取并交互任意网站数据

repos.name: KeygraphHQ/shannon
repos.description: Shannon is an AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes your source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove
repos.summary_zh: AI 渗透测试员，直接分析源码并执行真实攻击验证漏洞，上线前就能证明风险

repos.name: index-tts/index-tts
repos.description: An Industrial-Level Controllable and Efficient Zero-Shot Text-To-Speech System
repos.summary_zh: 工业级零样本语音合成系统，支持精细控制与高效生成，让AI声音克隆更自然可控

repos.name: openobserve/openobserve
repos.description: Open source observability platform for logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, pipelines and LLM observability. A sophisticated, simple and highly
repos.summary_zh: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog 与 Splunk，日志指标追踪全搞定，存储成本暴降 90%

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: semantica-agi/semantica
repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.summary_zh: 图原生基础设施让 AI 上下文可追溯可审计，构建负责任的智能系统

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 纯 C99 单 CPU 跑 2.78 万亿参数大模型，仅需 8.24GB 内存，无任何依赖

repos.name: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
repos.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling f
repos.summary_zh: LLM 应用流量路由网关，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 协议，灵活切换模型并优化成本与性能

repos.name: patchy631/time-to-first-token
repos.description: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for LLM inference serving and optimization. vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, benchmarking.
repos.summary_zh: 十天三十分钟的 LLM 推理优化路线图，覆盖 vLLM、量化与投机解码，助你快速上手生产级部署

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: unslothai/unsloth
repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.summary_zh: 本地界面一键运行和微调大模型与扩散模型，速度翻倍且显存占用减半，支持最新架构

repos.name: Lightricks/LTX-2
repos.description: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.
repos.summary_zh: LTX-2 官方推理与 LoRA 训练工具，让音频视频生成模型轻松定制专属风格

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 专测多模态大模型原子级视觉感知的基准，用细粒度任务暴露模型视而不见的盲区

repos.name: ZhuWenjie98/MMOOC
repos.description: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 首个多模态大模型上下文外评估基准，专测模型在图文错配场景下的鲁棒性与推理一致性

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: 模块化节点式扩散模型工作流神器，拖拽连线即可搭建图像生成与后端API，灵活度碾压传统GUI

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-component
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 和 GPUI 构建跨平台桌面应用的组件库，让原生界面开发更高效

repos.name: lightningpixel/modly
repos.description: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images or prompt using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
repos.summary_zh: 本地 GPU 跑通文生 3D 模型，无需云端即可从图片或提示词直接生成可编辑模型

repos.name: Jakubantalik/thinking-orbs
repos.description: Dotted thought-orb loading indicators for AI & agent UIs, 9 tuned types, two sizes, auto dark/light
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AI 与 Agent 界面设计的点阵思考加载动画，九种调校样式自动适配明暗模式

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: public-apis/public-apis
repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: 免费API大全集，开发者找接口不用再翻遍全网，四千多星标一站式搞定

repos.name: practical-tutorials/project-based-learning
repos.description: Curated list of project-based tutorials
repos.summary_zh: 按项目学编程的精选教程合集，覆盖多语言多领域，让动手实践成为最佳学习路径

repos.name: 3b1b/manim
repos.description: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
repos.summary_zh: 用代码驱动数学动画的引擎，让复杂公式变成直观视觉故事，3B1B 视频背后的开源利器

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 和 Tree-sitter 团队打造的 Rust 高性能编辑器，多人实时协作让编码如思维般流畅

papers.title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
papers.abstract: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogate
papers.summary_zh: 提出解析先验框架融合有限元数据，仅用少量样本即可精准预测矩形支管亥姆霍兹共振器降噪频率，显著提升数据效率与泛化能力

papers.title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于深度学习的微流控CTC表型分类方法，无需标记即可高效识别细胞大小与变形性，提升分类可解释性并显著降低数据需求

papers.title: The canonical facets of multi-separator polytopes
papers.abstract: We initiate a polyhedral study of the graph multi-separator problem proposed by Irmai et al. (2024) as an alternative to the lifted multicut problem for application to the task of image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh: 首次从多面体视角刻画图多分隔符问题，给出完整ILP表述及多分隔符多面体的规范刻面，为图像分割提供新理论框架

papers.title: Improving the matrix multiplication exponent with modern optimization and AlphaEvolve
papers.abstract: The current best bounds on the matrix multiplication exponent $ω$ are obtained through a refinement of the laser method called combination loss analysis (Duan et al., 2022; Williams et al., 2024; Alma
papers.summary_zh: 利用现代优化与AlphaEvolve改进组合损失分析，将矩阵乘法指数ω下界突破至2.53，较此前最优结果提升约0.001

papers.title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: err
papers.summary_zh: 提出智能体子任务探索与转换感知记忆机制，解决长时程操作误差累积问题，显著提升多阶段任务成功率并降低约束传递干扰

papers.title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-
papers.summary_zh: 提出层级动作流与谱潜在强化学习方法，使通用VLA适配人形全身操作，显著提升高维运动控制稳定性与任务成功率

papers.title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
papers.abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instruc
papers.summary_zh: 提出策略迭代与人类反馈结合方法，将后训练强化学习引入上下文学习，实现无需梯度更新的模型行为自适应优化

papers.title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
papers.abstract: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over
papers.summary_zh: 提出视频世界模型随机动力学物理校准基准，细粒度检验特定现象偶然不确定性，弥补现有粗粒度分布评估缺陷

papers.title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. In
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于Q函数的变分逆强化学习框架，无需显式奖励即可推断人类偏好，在连续控制任务中显著提升策略学习效率与鲁棒性

papers.title: Spectral Gaps of Hit-and-Run and Coordinate Hit-and-Run
papers.abstract: For any convex body $\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n}$ containing a unit ball, the spectral gap of Hit-and-Run is $Ω(1/(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}))$, where $C_{\mathsf{PI}}$ is the Poincaré constant of the
papers.summary_zh: 证明含单位球的凸体上Hit-and-Run谱隙下界为Ω(1/(n²C_PI))，并推广至坐标Hit-and-Run，给出其收敛性保证

papers.title: AutoSR: Automatic Symbolic Regression by Searching Research States
papers.abstract: We introduce Automatic Symbolic Regression (AutoSR), a fully automated system that instantiates Research-Space Symbolic Regression by searching persistent scientific investigations rather than isolate
papers.summary_zh: 提出自动符号回归系统AutoSR，通过搜索持久科研状态替代孤立方程，在有限噪声数据中稳定发现竞争性表达式，显著提升回归鲁棒性与效率

papers.title: Impression Share Prediction: An Offline Evaluation Task for Ranking Systems
papers.abstract: Offline evaluation is a major gateway before online evaluation of ranking models in A/B testing. Standard offline metrics measure predictive accuracy, but are only a surrogate for downstream utility:
papers.summary_zh: 提出印象份额预测作为排序系统离线评估新任务，聚焦曝光分布而非预测精度，弥补传统指标与下游效用间的缺口
